Hand-crafted fixture for ARX-CONSTRUCTS-361.

Covers plain TeX `\def\foo#1{[#1]}` macro definition and expansion at multiple
call sites in body text. Confirms the macro engine handles `\def` (not just
`\newcommand`) with a single mandatory argument and parameter substitution
(`#1`).

See src/arxiv_md/tex/macros.py.
